title: knowledge(performance): add community rules for performance
summary: Community performance guidance is added to the quality repository with 16 AL code examples covering partial records, HTTP deferral, multi-company access, page I/O, number-series batching, and database patterns.
key_points: 16 performance rules added with paired bad/good AL examples and markdown documentation
Covers critical patterns like partial-record behavior, transaction-safe HTTP handling, and ChangeCompany optimization
Includes guidance on cue performance, lookup pages, data access intent, and session I/O best practices
Obsolete rules like CountApprox guidance and unsupported FlowField rules removed
Examples validated against current AL APIs
